items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Wilson, violinist, one of the best

ctx.x: And who was in the band?

Myself, trombone player; Eugene Primos, drums; and called him 'Jesse' Wilson. Ralph Wilson, violinist, one of the best... Let's see who else. Percy - I think it's Percy Sutton, piano player. I'm not sure, I know his first name was Percy.
And how long did you stay with that band?
